title: Platform-specific Darwin ARM64 binaries are declared as direct devDependencies
reasoning: These packages are OS/CPU-specific binary builds. Declaring them as first-class devDependencies makes install/build behavior host-dependent and can fail in Linux/Windows CI or non-ARM64 machines with unsupported platform errors.
recommendation: Remove direct platform-targeted binary packages from devDependencies and rely on cross-platform parent packages/transitive optional dependencies instead.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No install-matrix or CI validation is included in the provided evidence, so cross-platform dependency resolution failures would not be caught by tests here.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add CI jobs that run dependency installation and build on at least linux-x64 and darwin-arm64.
